title: The dual role of borohydride salts in enhancing perovskite solar cell performance and stability
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1069-1079
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01476J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Teresa Diaz-Perez, Carina Pareja-Rivera, Jorge Pascual, Hector Juarez S., Sofia Masi, Eva M. Barea, Silver-Hamill Turren-Cruz, Iván Mora-Seró
KBH4 and NaBH4 prevent oxidation and passivate defects in perovskites. Both increase grain size and efficiency, but NaBH4 offers superior performance, boosting shelf life 5-fold (>900 h) in 60% humidity compared to reference devices.
